title: Try to Kill Ratsputin
description: Try to Kill Ratsputin — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Slay Ratsputin

Quest Reward: 75000 Gold and 10 Kings Coins

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: Yes

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill Ratsputin, again, in his lair off of Level 7 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to the Townston Commander.

Offer:

Ok, look, when I say to slay Ratsputin I'm not telling you to go and bonk him on the head and call it a day. Here, let me read to you the definition of the word dead... just let me get my book with the words in it... and here it is. Dead, noun, no longer living; deprived of life. See, what you did to Ratsputin was definitely not that. You may have deprived him of a fifteen minute break but it certainly wasn't his LIFE!

Get back out there to Ratsputin's lair off of Level 7 of Ratsputin's Gulag and show him a little death. Not just a taste, so he knows what he's missing, no I want you to give him to whole thing. No discounts. No refunds. No take-backs. Just some plain old death, Dungeon Runner style! When he is dead return to me, the Townston Commander, here in Townston.

Turn-in:

I see you have returned. Well, did you kill Ratsputin. You did. Well, I can't say that I am full of butterflies seeing as how I just saw that he logged in to the PVP server.... I promised you a reward though, and seeing as how you killed Ratsputin I can't just not pay you because he decided not to stay dead. Let me know if you want to try to kill Ratsputin again.

Objectives:

  • Try and Kill Ratsputin

Level range: 75–100
